name: arma3-server-tools-monorepo
description: Arma3 Server Tools — Vue + Electron + Service monorepo

scripts.build:all: npm run build:service && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @a3st/api-client run typecheck && npm -w @a3st/service run typecheck
scripts.clean: npm -w @a3st/web run clean 2>/dev/null; npm -w @a3st/service run clean 2>/dev/null; rm -rf packages/service/dist packages/web/dist
